purpose: Check whether the two cycling panels of one sealed pomelo source support early-window inputs for external prediction.
exposure_policy: Only early trace pixels through the previously sealed inward 20% bound. Axis labels may be inspected in a separately masked strip outside the plot. Never display full panels, raw captions or results paragraphs. Return filtered protocol facts only. Any exposure routes the entire paper to development.
marker_gate: At least three individually resolved positive-cycle markers belonging to the same sample and test. Exclude a normalization origin and points whose geometry interval crosses a window boundary. Connected trace pixels, imposed grids and interpolation do not count.
protocol_gate: Explicit sample and panel binding, electrode system and reported cycling current, with normalization and other input provenance documented. Holds stay unresolved when the published evidence cannot support these fields.
fitting_and_acceptance: Zero fits or score comparisons. A source may proceed to a separate frozen prediction lock only after input review. No endpoint extraction or acceptance in this phase.
